facts.business: Premier Limited is an Indian company undergoing Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) since January 29, 2021, with operations suspended and no revenue-generating activities during FY2026.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis on going concern basis during CIRP; title deeds of immovable properties mortgaged to banks and assigned to Edelweiss Asset Reconstruction Company Limited (EARC), but confirmation from EARC not made available; statutory dues arrears outstanding for more than six months including Income Tax (Rs 114.61 lakh), Profession Tax (Rs 26.05 lakh), Local Body Tax (Rs 408.22 lakh), Provident Fund (Rs 282.77 lakh), and ESIC (Rs 3.46 lakh); cost records not maintained as no operations carried out during the year.

key_risks: Company under CIRP since January 29, 2021 with Board of Directors suspended
Going concern uncertainty pending resolution plan approval by NCLT
No operations carried out during FY2026
Significant statutory dues arrears outstanding for more than six months
Title deeds of immovable properties held by EARC, confirmation not available
Investment in associate PAL Credit and Capital Limited fully provided for (Rs 651.70 lakh)
Loans to related party PALCC of Rs 385.25 lakh fully provided for
Pending litigation for transfer of shares in Pal-Peugeot Ltd (under liquidation)
facts.related_party_note: Loans to related party PAL Credit and Capital Limited (associate, 27.31% shareholding) of Rs 385.25 lakh fully provided for; no interest charged on outstanding amount; investment in PALCC fully impaired (Rs 651.70 lakh).
